headline: Sharp Fighting Renewed at Gutter as Marban and Expanse Lines Shift
war_summary: Fighting broke out afresh along the Gutter in the past watch, where eleven actions in two hours left its seven works four Warden, one Colonial and two unclaimed, Kuoppa the busiest ground. Marban Hollow, quiet at the last edition, has been reworked: its eight works now stand three Warden, three Colonial and two unclaimed, with eleven actions in six hours. In the Weathered Expanse, still the war's heaviest field at twenty-nine actions in the day, Wardens have improved their footing to five works of nine, though both sides pay dear, roughly 167 Colonial and 324 Warden losses in the past hour alone, both climbing. Godcrofts, silent at the previous report, has fired again, two actions in two hours. The Nevish Line has gone quiet for two hours while its losses run 206 Colonial and 138 Warden an hour. Palantine Berm remains brisk with eight actions in two hours, holding six Colonial works to one Warden. Callahans Passage records no ground changed hands but the heaviest daily toll of the war, 11,273 Colonial and 7,901 Warden. On day 643 the victory mark stands at thirty-four towns, Colonials holding 301 works to 126 Warden and nine unclaimed.
